Thanks Liam — received the W-9 and utility bill. A few quick asks so we can complete the vendor master record and map the PO routing: 

1) Please confirm the exact legal name to be used on our ledger (as it should appear on purchase orders and contracts). The W-9 says 'Argus Labs, Inc.' but sometimes the bank paperwork uses a shortened name — we'd like an explicit confirmation.

2) Could you attach a scanned Certificate of Formation (or Articles) showing the registered name and state of incorporation? This speeds up tax/entity verification.

3) Confirm EIN as shown on the W-9 (last four digits are sufficient in email if you prefer not to send the full SSN/EIN by regular email).

4) For PO acceptance, please confirm: preferred remit-to email for invoices, and whether Argus requires invoices to reference a specific PO line (e.g., 'PO# required on invoice: yes/no').

5) We're attaching our vendor onboarding form — please complete pages 1–2 and return. Also cc AP if you want direct follow-up (Jonas handles AP mapping).

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Argus.docx

We'll hold off finalizing the vendor record until we have these confirmations and the incorporation doc. If you prefer, Jonas can send a short DocuSign for bank details so you don't email banking info.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov

Olga — thanks for looping me in. A couple procurement checklist items to note for Argus Labs before we flip to production:

- Entity classification: We need the state of incorporation and confirmation that the legal name on the Articles matches the W-9. If there are DBA or trade names, list them separately.
- Tax matching: confirm EIN (last 4) against W-9. If the W-9 was signed by an agent, we still accept it but will request a secondary proof if AP flags a mismatch during first invoice.
- Payment terms: default net30 unless counter-offered. Please advise if Argus requests net45 or any early-pay discounts.
- PO workflow: Redwood issues a PO number from our ERP for orders >$500. For smaller ad-hoc purchases we'll use an internal requisition code. Argus should indicate on invoices: "PO#XXXX" when invoicing for PO'd work.

I've attached the PO channel questionnaire — Jonas, please add AP-specific fields for bank format and ACH vs wire preference. Liam — if you can return the onboarding form and Articles, we'll run the entity verification and push the record into staging.

Attachments: PO_Channel_Questionnaire.pdf

Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Hi Liam — copying AP instructions so we can finalize remit routing. A few items from AP: 

1) Please confirm the exact legal remittance address (for 1099 and checks): is it the same as the utility bill address (2898 Meridian Ave, Suite 400, San Diego, CA 92101)? If Argus uses a different address for invoices, note it explicitly.

2) Preferred payment rail: ACH is preferred (faster, lower fees). If ACH, we'll need completed ACH form — I've created a DocuSign for bank account authorization: https://www.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE-ARGUS-BANKFORM — please sign and return.

3) Invoice requirements: AP requires invoices to include (a) our PO number when available, (b) vendor legal name exactly as in the vendor master, (c) remit-to instructions or bank details, and (d) one contact person for overdue/chargeback issues.

4) Address normalization note: Our ERP uses a single-line normalized address field. If Argus wants invoices routed to a specific department, indicate "AP" or "Billing" in the remit contact line.

Once we have the Articles and the completed onboarding form, I will create the vendor record in staging and share the vendor ID for Argus to reference on invoices.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Accounts Payable Lead
Redwood Inference
